newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel closed slightly lower on Thursday against the dollar and the basket of foreign currencies in quiet trading, dealers said.

"Activity rose slightly today and the shekel weakened mildly against the dollar. The session opened with some demand for the dollar and it rose to 3.2550 shekels, but towards the end of the trading day it started falling," said one dealer.
"The dollar traded during the week in tight ranges and remains stable. The basket rose because of the mark's gains abroad," he said.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2480 shekels against 3.2460 on Wednesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6537 shekels against 3.6402 on Wednesday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9043 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8466 on Wednesday and against the mark at 2.1547 shekels against 2.1358 on Wednesday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2450 shekels.
